Name: Simple Item Spawner
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]🎒 Simple Item Spawner[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#FDE68A][b]For PC single-player. Multiplayer and split-screen are disabled.[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#D8B4FE]Mod Requested By: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Harold45][b]Harold45[/b][/url][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]✨ Find & Spawn Items[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]• [b]Find items:[/b] search names or item IDs, browse 19 categories, filter by source and sort by name, category, ID or value.
• [b]Choose quality and quantity:[/b] Normal, Silver, Gold or Iridium for eligible items, with exact amounts up to the native stack limit. Equipment stays at one.
• [b]Keep favourites and recent choices:[/b] save up to 500 favourites across saves and 50 recent item/quality choices per farmer and save.
• [b]Reuse item sets:[/b] save up to 20 sets of 36 entries. Rename, reorder and edit each entry’s quantity and quality before spawning.
• [b]Inspect items:[/b] hover catalogue items or your backpack to see the game’s full item information.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54012/54012-1792278831-562099974.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#A7F3D0][b]🎒 Backpack or Nearby Drops[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Your backpack opens below the catalogue by default, showing its live contents. Spawned items use normal inventory stacking and capacity rules. This display is for viewing existing items.

Choose [b]Close Backpack[/b] to hide it and drop new items near your player. [b]Open Backpack[/b] restores direct inventory delivery. Dropped items follow normal pickup behaviour.

If an inventory request does not fit, the remainder stays in [b]Pending[/b]. Free space and choose Retry. Requests keep their original destination when you change the backpack toggle.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]🔎 Item Information & Other Mods[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Registered modded inventory items and their loaded artwork are included. Native tooltip hooks let compatible information mods extend the item popup.

Optional hover adapters support [b]Lookup Anything 1.55.0[/b] and [b]UI Info Suite 2 Alternative 2.9.0/2.9.1[/b], including when the catalogue is opened over a backpack menu. Lookup Anything uses its configured lookup key. Other versions can use the standard hovered-item interface and native tooltip hooks.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/52279]Simple Backpack Upgrade[/url]’s 48, 60, 72 and 84 unlocked slots are available in the backpack display. The assigned opening shortcut also works over its standalone expanded inventory view and returns to that view when closed.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54012/54012-1792278835-973549286.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🎮 Getting Started[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Open the normal [b]backpack tab[/b] and choose the catalogue shortcut. An optional opening binding can be assigned in the built-in Settings screen or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]; it starts unassigned.

Select an item, choose its quality using the header stars, and open its details to change the amount. [b]Spawn item[/b] displays that amount. Selecting an item alone does not grant it. Eligible catalogue selections remember your chosen quality; recent items and saved sets keep their own recorded quantities and quality.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#A7F3D0][b]📦 Requirements & Installation[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB][b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI 4.5.2+[/b][/url]. GMCM, Lookup Anything and UI Info Suite are optional.

Extract [b]SimpleItemSpawner[/b] into [b]Mods[/b] and launch through SMAPI. For updates, replace the program files while preserving [b]config.json[/b] and the [b]data[/b] folder. Remove this mod’s folder to uninstall; follow the supplying mod’s instructions before removing a mod that provides spawned items.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]ℹ Good to Know[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Quest, wallet, recipe, pickup-flag, error and mannequin entries are excluded. Items are created with fresh default state. World drops are inventory items, not placed furniture, machines or NPCs. There is no existing-item editor or undo. CJB Item Spawner is not required.

Twelve languages are included. Generative AI assisted with code, translations and page copy; item artwork comes from your game and content packs. The gallery uses native menu renders prepared outside a played game session.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Please share reports and ideas on this page. For bugs, include your mod, game and SMAPI versions, platform, expected versus actual behaviour, reproduction steps and a [url=https://smapi.io/log]shared SMAPI log[/url]. A screenshot or short video can help. For suggestions, explain what you would change and how it would help.[/color][/size][/center]
